standard_prerequisites.name: Local description of the extended alternating complex
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the covering U_i = D(f_i) of X - Z and the complex of equation-extended-alternating.

standard_prerequisites.name: Alternating Cech complexes are trivial over a member
standard_prerequisites.use: The alternating Cech complex of a covering restricted to an open contained in one member is homotopic to zero.

core_obligations: Acyclicity is stalk-local: evaluate the restricted complex of sheaves on opens W of X - Z.
At a point x outside Z = V(f_1, ..., f_c) some f_i is invertible; choose W around x contained in the corresponding member U_i = D(f_i).
On such W the evaluated complex is the alternating Cech complex of a covering with W inside one member; by the triviality lemma it is homotopic to zero.
Conclude every stalk of the restricted complex vanishes, i.e., the complex is acyclic on X - Z.
proof_roadmap: Stalk-local evaluation; member selection at each point; triviality lemma; acyclicity conclusion.
difficulty_reason: A localization argument feeding a standard Cech triviality; short but with a real stalk-level setup.
